    AI Overview
    NCIS
     killed off Director Leon Vance (Rocky Carroll) in the 500th episode (Season 23) to create a high-stakes, shocking moment to mark the milestone. Executive producer Steven D. Binder deemed it a "love letter" to the character, aiming to send shockwaves through the fan base after almost 18 seasons. 
    Key Reasons for Vance's Death: 
    • Milestone Impact: Producers wanted a dramatic, groundbreaking event for the 500th episode to shake up the series after 23 seasons.
    • Creative Decision: It was not the actor's choice to leave, but a creative decision from the production team, says Us Weekly.
    • Full Circle Ending: The writers felt it was a fitting time for the character to have a final, significant story arc, says Yahoo.
    • The "Long Life" Argument: After 18 seasons (beginning in Season 5, as a regular in Season 6), the producers felt it was the right time to say goodbye to the character, according to a Variety interview with Rocky Carroll. 
    Rocky Carroll, who has directed episodes of NCIS, expressed that he was at peace with the decision after such a long tenure, notes Malaysia Yahoo News.

    AI Overview
    Breena Palmer, wife of NCIS medical examiner Jimmy Palmer,
    died from COVID-19 complications, as revealed in Season 18, Episode 7 ("The First Day"). Her death occurred off-screen during the height of the pandemic, allowing the show to reflect real-world losses while driving Jimmy's storyline and testing his optimism. 
    Key details about her departure: 
    • Cause of Death: She passed away from COVID-19 complications in December 2020, as stated in the episode "The First Day".
    • Off-Screen Death: Her death occurred off-screen between episodes, which surprised viewers, with Jimmy explaining the tragic loss to his team.
    • Storyline Purpose:
      Producers felt it was important to have a pandemic-related loss in the series to honor real-world events, but chose not to kill off a core team member.
    • Impact: The loss of his wife deeply affected Jimmy and compelled him to raise their daughter, Victoria, as a single father with help from his mother. 
    Breena, played by Michelle Pierce, was a recurring character from season 7 through 10.
